name: 单样本 Z 检验计算器

map.已知总体标准差时，检验样本均值是否偏离假设值。: When the population standard deviation is known, tests whether the sample mean departs from a hypothesized value.
map.📖 查看「单样本 Z 检验计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "One-Sample z-Test Calculator User Guide"
map.双侧 p = 2(1−Φ(|z|))；z=2 时双侧 p≈0.046。 σ 已知: Two-tailed p = 2(1−Φ(|z|)); at z=2 the two-tailed p≈0.046. Use the z-test when σ is known.
map.双侧 p = 2(1−Φ(|z|))，z=2 时双侧 p≈0.046（正确拒绝: Two-tailed p = 2(1−Φ(|z|)); at z=2 the two-tailed p≈0.046 (H₀ correctly rejected).
map.σ 已知时使用 Z 检验。: Use the z-test when σ is known.
map.σ 已知时检验均值：z=(x̄−m0)/(σ/√n)。: Testing the mean when σ is known: z=(x̄−m0)/(σ/√n).
map.大样本近似也常用。: Also common as a large-sample approximation.
map.n=100：z=5/(15/10)=3.333，p≈0.0009，高度显著。: With n=100: z=5/(15/10)=3.333, p≈0.0009, highly significant.
map.z 和 t 检验结果差异？: How do z and t test results differ?
map.σ 已知/大样本用 z 偏宽松；σ 未知小样本用 t 更保守，差异随 n 增大而: The z-test with known σ or large samples is more liberal; the t-test for unknown σ in small samples is more conservative, and the gap closes as n grows.
map.默认双尾（检验\"是否相等\"）；若有方向假设（>或<）用单尾，p 减半。: Two-tailed by default (testing whether they are equal); with a directional hypothesis (> or <) use one tail and halve p.
